candidates.change_summary: Change `withdraw(address(this).balance)` to `withdraw(0)` so withdrawAll transfers nothing.
Delete the call to `withdraw(address(this).balance)` so withdrawAll performs no transfer.
Change `require(msg.sender == owner)` to `require(msg.sender != owner)` so only non-owners can call owner-restricted functions.
Remove the `require` statement so anyone can call owner-restricted functions.
Replace `payable(msg.sender).transfer(_value)` with `payable(owner).transfer(_value)` so funds go to owner instead of caller.
Replace `payable(msg.sender).transfer(_value)` with no-op by removing the transfer statement, leaving the function body empty.
Replace the transfer amount `_value` with `address(this).balance` so the whole balance is withdrawn regardless of argument.
Remove the `require` statement from the modifier, making `onlyOwner` grant access to everyone.
Replace `msg.sender == owner` with `true`, effectively removing the access control check.
Replace _target.call{value: _value}("") with payable(_target).transfer(_value) to change sendMoney behavior from call to transfer (different gas and revert behavior).
Remove the if (! _s) revert condition so that failed calls do not revert, causing sendMoney to succeed silently even when the external call fails.
Replace revert() with require(false) to change revert error type while preserving revert behavior.
